latest_teacher_action.diagnosis: The previous prompt kept all objects in one generic scene, but it did not force a rigid countable layout or make the nonstandard attributes visually explicit enough. The generator likely treated the croissants and trumpets as secondary or merged details, causing missing or wrong counts, while 'wooden croissants' and 'striped turtles' were too weakly bound. The under relation was also underspecified because 'directly underneath' did not require a clean row-to-row alignment for every turtle under the croissant band.
expected_improvement: Increase recognition of exactly seven croissants by using a single top row with seven separate visible instances.
Increase recognition of wooden croissants by explicitly describing each croissant as carved from wood with visible wood grain.
Increase recognition of exactly five white trumpets by placing them in a separate row with five fully visible individual instruments.
Increase recognition of striped turtles by explicitly requiring visible stripe patterns on each turtle shell.
Increase success on the under relation by using three horizontal bands: croissants on top, turtles below them, trumpets in a separate bottom band.
preserve_constraints: Keep exactly five turtles present and fully visible.
Keep croissants present in the image.
Keep all objects separate, unobstructed, and easy to count.

previous_plan_error.details: The plan relied on a general 'upper part' and 'placed separately' composition, which was too loose for strict counting and relation verification. It also named attributes once without reinforcing them at the instance level, so wooden croissants and striped turtles were not visually dominant cues.

latest_teacher_action.regeneration_strategy: Switch to a stricter diagram-like composition with three horizontal rows and explicit per-object visibility. Use exact counts, instance separation, and explicit negative clauses against extra objects or merged duplicates. Strengthen attribute binding by repeating the target attribute with the target noun and adding concrete visual cues such as wood grain on every croissant and visible stripes on every turtle shell.
regression_risks: The passed white color on trumpets could regress if the new prompt overemphasizes layout more than trumpet appearance.
The passed turtle count of five could regress if the generator adds extra small turtles while trying to satisfy the striped attribute.
Croissant presence could remain but count could still drift if the top row is crowded.
repair_constraints: Show exactly seven wooden croissants, all fully visible, as seven separate croissants in one horizontal top row.
Make each croissant clearly wooden with visible wood grain; all seven croissants are wooden.
Show exactly five striped turtles, all fully visible, as five separate turtles in one horizontal middle row directly below the croissant row.
Make the stripe pattern clearly visible on each turtle shell; all five turtles are striped.
Ensure the turtles are under the croissants with a clean top-row croissants / middle-row turtles layout.
Show exactly five white trumpets, all fully visible, as five separate trumpets in one horizontal bottom row away from the turtles and croissants.
Do not include extra croissants, extra turtles, extra trumpets, duplicate objects, merged objects, or partial cropped objects.
latest_teacher_action.retry_prompt: A simple clean scene with three horizontal rows of objects on a plain background. Top row: exactly seven separate wooden croissants, fully visible, evenly spaced, each croissant clearly made of wood with visible wood grain. Middle row directly below the croissants: exactly five separate turtles, fully visible, evenly spaced, each turtle clearly striped with visible stripes on its shell. Bottom row: exactly five separate white trumpets, fully visible, evenly spaced, clearly distinct from the turtles and croissants. The five turtles are under the seven wooden croissants. Every object is unobstructed, not touching, not overlapping, and easy to count. No extra croissants, no extra turtles, no extra trumpets, no duplicate objects, no cropped objects.

skill_revision.reason: Persistent count and missing-object failures indicate the retry needs stronger exclusion language against extras, merged instances, and omitted trumpets, while keeping the existing layout and visibility skills.

The under relation was also underspecified because 'directly underneath' did not require a clean row-to-row alignment for every turtle under the croissant band.
